turns.question: It's the end of 5 October 2026 and our fiscal year starts on 1 February. What has our average daily revenue been so far this fiscal quarter, counting days with no orders as zero and leaving cancelled orders out?
turns.answer: Average daily revenue this fiscal quarter (1 August to 5 October 2026, 66 days, with days without revenue counted as zero) is EUR 296.57 per day: the Revenue (EUR) metric, which sums non-cancelled orders, totals EUR 19,573.59 over those days, and the average divides that by 66. The semantic layer has no average-daily-revenue metric of its own, so this uses revenue_eur. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
